title: WAFFLE POD SLAB
hook: THERE'S POLYSTYRENE / UNDER A LOT OF / NEW HOUSES.

title: TILT-UP PANEL
hook: THESE WALLS / ARE POURED / LYING DOWN.

title: BRICK VENEER WALL
hook: THAT BRICK HOUSE? / IT'S HELD UP / BY TIMBER.

title: SUPER-T BRIDGE
hook: MOST FREEWAY / BRIDGES START / IN A FACTORY.

title: LOAD-BEARING WALL OUT
hook: THAT WALL IS / HOLDING UP / YOUR CEILING.

title: BLOCK RETAINING WALL
hook: THAT WALL IS / HOLDING BACK / TONNES OF DIRT.

title: STEEL PORTAL FRAME
hook: A HUGE ROOF. / NOT ONE POST / IN THE MIDDLE.

title: SUSPENDED SLAB
hook: A CONCRETE FLOOR, / POURED IN / MID-AIR.

title: TIMBER WALL FRAME
hook: THE SKELETON / INSIDE EVERY / AUSSIE HOUSE.

title: BOX CULVERT
hook: THE CREEK UNDER / THIS ROAD RUNS / THROUGH A BOX.

title: RE-STUMPING
hook: SLOPING FLOORS? / STICKING DOORS? / CHECK THE STUMPS.

title: ROAD PAVEMENT
hook: THE BLACK STUFF / IS THE THIN BIT. / IT'S MOSTLY ROCK.

title: POST-TENSIONED SLAB
hook: THIS FLOOR HAS / STEEL CABLES / PULLED TIGHT.

title: CURTAIN WALL
hook: THAT GLASS WALL / HOLDS NOTHING UP. / IT HANGS ON HOOKS.

title: ROOF TRUSSES
hook: YOUR ROOF / WAS BUILT IN / A FACTORY.

title: NOISE WALL
hook: THAT FREEWAY WALL / STANDS ON / HIDDEN PILES.
